name: Status Badge
description: Neutral, non-interactive text label for an entity's current product-defined state. The component owns the compact presentation only; product logic owns status definitions and current values.

props.name: label
props.description: Required non-empty product-supplied state text such as Active or Invitation pending. The component does not interpret or map the label to a tone or status enum.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Neutral semantic-token surface with content-driven width and a fixed 28px height.

semantics.accessibleName: The visible label text communicates the entity state directly; meaning never depends on color alone.
semantics.focus: Status Badge is non-interactive, is not a keyboard focus target, and never moves focus.
requirements: label must be a non-empty string after trimming whitespace.
Status meaning remains understandable from visible text without color interpretation.
A static Status Badge is not an alert or live region; the containing workflow owns announcements for dynamic status changes when needed.
Status Badge is non-interactive, does not receive focus, and exposes no click, selection, dismiss, or keyboard behavior.
The root is exactly 28 CSS pixels high with 5 CSS pixels of block padding and 10 CSS pixels of inline padding; width grows with the label content.
The neutral surface uses surface/section, fg/primary, shape/surface, and label/small semantic tokens in Light and Dark modes.
Inline padding is direction-independent so English/LTR and Arabic/RTL use the same geometry.
Active and Invitation pending are example product-supplied labels, not component variants or a closed status enum.
No tone, size, icon, selected, dismissible, warning, success, critical, or interactive variant exists in version 1.0.0.
